entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A necromancer planeswalker teaching at Strixhaven, haunted by the Raven Man; she returns to her family estate on Dominaria and fights Phyrexians.

entities.name: Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A fractured necromantic spirit anchored to a ring who has haunted Liliana since her youth, grooming her as a vessel, and who warns her of the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Elas il-Kor
entities.description: A compleated kor Phyrexian leading a team of soldiers for Sheoldred to dig up the ring that anchors the Raven Man.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A Phyrexian praetor whose commands Elas il-Kor serves on Dominaria.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A fallen comrade of Liliana, whose name she holds as a broken bell and for whose sake she wants to end the Raven Man.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: The elder dragon of the War she lived through.

entities.name: Belzenlok
entities.description: A demon whose corruption still taints the Vess estate.

entities.name: Josu Vess
entities.description: A Vess ancestor linked to the family estate's history.

entities.name: Lady Ana
entities.description: A trainer in Liliana's youth with the Forward Order.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: A figure whose great betrayal all Dominarians know.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: Patchwork, artificial soldiers who gather at the Vess estate to find the ring.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: The group of planeswalkers Liliana once opposed or knew.

entities.name: Forward Order
entities.description: The order in which Liliana trained in her youth.

entities.name: Strixhaven
entities.description: The university on Arcavios where Liliana teaches and hides in academia.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane where Strixhaven stands.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: Liliana's home plane, where the Vess estate lies.

entities.name: Vess Manor
entities.description: Liliana's ruined family home in a corrupted swamp on Dominaria.

entities.name: Sedgemoor
entities.description: A necroluminescent swamp landscape at Strixhaven that Liliana loves.

entities.name: Biblioplex
entities.description: Strixhaven's great library where Liliana researches the Raven Man.

entities.name: Ring of Lim-Dûl
entities.description: A ring that anchors the Raven Man and is buried beneath the Vess graveyard, containing great necromantic power.

entities.name: Chain Veil
entities.description: An artifact Liliana once used and was freed of.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: The plane where Liliana's spark first carried her.

entities.name: Mirrodin
entities.description: The plane where Phyrexian contamination was thought contained.

events.summary: Liliana, a professor at Strixhaven, is visited in a dream by the Raven Man, who calls her to come home.
Hallucination or not, Liliana researches the Raven Man in the Biblioplex, where he appears again and urges her to search deeper.
events.quote: "You aren't going far enough back," he said.

events.summary: Liliana finds a name in A History of Terisiare, concludes the Raven Man is real, and resolves to destroy him for Gideon's sake.
events.quote: She could cleanse this tiny bit of evil from the Multiverse, for Gideon's sake.

events.summary: Liliana takes leave and planeswalks to Dominaria.
events.quote: "All right, you bastard," she said. "I'm coming home."

events.summary: Liliana arrives at the ruined Vess estate and falls asleep under the oak in the graveyard, where the Raven Man appears in a dream.
events.quote: the Raven Man stood before her

events.summary: Liliana names him Lim-Dûl and learns he wants her as Dominaria's weapon against a threat; he warns her to save herself.
events.quote: I called you to be Dominaria's weapon.

events.summary: Exploring the swamp, Liliana senses an alien taint and is confronted by Elas il-Kor, a kor Phyrexian, and a team of patchwork soldiers.
events.quote: "You have entered our gathering grounds, and you are thus forfeit."

events.summary: Elas il-Kor says her team is excavating to find an object anchoring the spirit; Liliana decides not to flee and to stop them.
events.quote: "The spirit we pursue is anchored to an object somewhere in this place,"

events.summary: Liliana raises the swamp's dead against the Phyrexians and retreats to her family graveyard.
events.quote: Liliana had the dead of an entire biome.

events.summary: Liliana blasts the Phyrexians with rotting light; Elas throws a javelin that wounds Liliana's shoulder.
events.quote: it struck Liliana in the shoulder.

events.summary: Reaching into the ring's power, Liliana sees the history of the Raven Man's necromancer lineage and that she was meant to be the next vessel, but refuses.
events.quote: She had been intended as one more link in a line stretching back to that first, now-nameless mage

events.summary: Liliana raises the dead Phyrexians against Elas il-Kor, who flees.
events.quote: Then, choosing survival over her soldiers' fate, she fled.

events.summary: Liliana buries the ring deeper beneath Dominaria to deny the Phyrexians and planeswalks back to Arcavios.
events.quote: she pushed the artifact downward, commanding the ancient dead to hide the object away

events.summary: The Raven Man watches her leave, content that he manipulated her into protecting him.
events.quote: She had protected him, in the end.

relations.note: Haunts her and shaped her into a vessel; she wants to be free of him.
relations.quote: "He's haunted me since I was a young woman, and I would be free of him."

relations.note: He cultivated and molded her as his intended vessel.
relations.quote: You were molding me into your perfect vessel.
But what Sheoldred commanded, she would have
that meant Dominaria, and more, it meant the Vess family estate

relations.note: Liliana fights partly for Gideon's sake.
